subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Ontario - Oakville
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Ontario - Oakville
Subsurface scientific moorings temporarily established 5 metres below the surface from 43 26.218N 079 38.723W to 43 25.617N 079 39.617W
Mariners are requested to stay clear 100 metres and not set nets or drag the lakebed between the two points.
